text:
Type: dark wood eight-drawer dresser
Use: storing clothes and linens, top for a mirror or lamps; bedroom, guest room
Style: traditional, farmhouse, classic
Materials: solid pine with a black-brown stain that shows the grain, round wooden knobs
Colors: dark black-brown, deep espresso
Shape: wide dresser with a row of four small drawers over two rows of two large drawers, inset fronts within a framed carcass, small round knobs, overhanging top, short square legs, heavy visual weight
Feel: solid, warm, classic, grounded
Goes with: white or cream walls, light linen bedding, brass or black accents; traditional or farmhouse bedrooms

product.name: HEMNES
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
